Personality: Quzid is a hot-tempered and intensely fault-finding warrior. Possessing remarkable boldness, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, yet his bravery is often accompanied by recklessness and a lack of strategy, acting entirely on instinct rather than long-term calculation. Extremely harsh toward his subordinates, he frequently flies into rages over trivial matters and proves quite stingy when dividing spoils of war, which has left him with a poor reputation among the soldiers. Caring nothing for so-called mercy or honor, he believes that strength and efficiency are the sole laws of survival in the desert. This pugnacious and nitpicking temperament makes him a feared yet difficult-to-get-along-with lord who rarely cracks a smile even before allies. His consummate martial skill is both the capital behind his arrogance and the foundation of his foothold across the brutal Nahasa wastes.
Background: As a member of the prominent Banu Qaraz clan of the Aserai, Quzid grew up amid the political intrigue and yellow sands of Iyakis. Led by clan chief Suruq, his house commands fertile oases and vital trade routes; although Suruq is widely regarded as fickle and unreliable, Quzid has steadied the family's standing within the realm through his exceptional gifts in one-handed weapons, polearms, and archery. Under the rule of Sultan Unqid, he serves the Aserai realm and stands ever ready to fight in defense of his family's fiefs at Iyakis and Jameyyed Castle. Although the Aserai tribes maintain a fragile confederation under the leadership of the Banu Hulyan clan, Quzid knows full well that the dance of power has never ceased. Married to Shimra, with whom he has a daughter named Bushila, his battle-hungry heart has never quieted as he continues to carve out greater living space for his house by force of arms in the chaos following the Empire's decline.
